fin_cin7.title: Import from Cin7 Core
fin_cin7.subtitle: Bring products, opening stock, customers, suppliers and bills of materials across from Cin7 exports. Preview first: nothing is saved until you import.
fin_cin7.banner: Moving from Cin7 Core? Import its products, opening stock by warehouse and batch, customers, suppliers and BOMs.
fin_cin7.order_hint: Import in this order: products, then stock, then customers and suppliers, then BOMs.

entity_hint.products: Cin7 Products export: SKU, name, unit, average cost, reorder level, BOM flag.
entity_hint.stock: Cin7 Stock on hand export: SKU, location, batch/serial, expiry, on hand, unit cost. Posts opening stock to the ledger.
entity_hint.customers: Cin7 Customers export: name, account, terms, credit limit, discount, tax number.
entity_hint.suppliers: Cin7 Suppliers export: name, terms, tax number. Also creates the procurement supplier.
entity_hint.boms: Cin7 Bill of materials export: assembly SKU, component SKU, quantity, wastage. Created as drafts for an engineer to approve.

fin_cin7.map_hint: Leave a location blank to create a warehouse with its name.
fin_cin7.fix_first: Fix the errors in the file, then preview again. An import is all or nothing.
fin_cin7.reupload: The file stays selected; Import sends it again.
